title: First-Run Spotlight: Progressive Checklist & Contextual Empty States
creator: Priya Shah
description: Design and asset set for a progressive first-run spotlight tour that combines a lightweight checklist rail with contextual empty-state cards. Purpose: reduce time-to-first-success for new users by surfacing 3 core tasks (Create API Key, Run Quickstart, Connect a Model) while avoiding modal fatigue. Focus is on composable assets, accessible motion, and microcopy variants for PLG funnel experiments.
background: Research from onboarding analytics and support logs shows a 22% dropoff during first token generation and a disproportionate number of support tickets about 'where to create an API key' and 'how to test a model'. Previous quickstarts were modal-heavy and not surfaced in the workspace canvas. This ticket prototypes a persistent spotlight rail + contextual empty states that adapt to user progress and product tier.
acceptance_criteria: Three milestone cards implemented as design tokens: API Key, Quickstart Run, Model Connect
Empty-state art and 3 copy variants for A/B testing (friendly, terse, enterprise) exported to PNG/SVG
Accessibility pass: contrast, keyboard focus, and reduced-motion alternatives documented
Hand-off package uploaded to Figma with component variants and dev spec frames
Sign-off from Product and Engineering on interaction details and API contract for progress tracking
decisions: Persistent rail chosen over modal to reduce interruption and support multi-step workflows
Progress tracked via client-side telemetry events (ENG-3301) rather than server-side flags to preserve offline-first UX
Microcopy variants will be managed under a single copy key to simplify experiments and translations
Animations reduced to subtle fades and scale; reduced-motion pref honored
tradeoffs: Persistent UI increases chrome on the canvas but improves discoverability — decided to collapse by default for small screens
Client-side progress events add complexity to onboarding metrics but allow instant UI updates without round trips
Single-rail approach limits parallel guidance; we will include inline links from other empty states (follow-up task)
